definition: Awarded each week to the losing team with the highest projection-based win probability immediately before the first Monday Night Football kickoff.
capturePoint: The capture workflow records ESPN live projected totals in the 30 minutes before the first Monday Night Football kickoff. Nothing is back-filled or estimated after the fact.
probabilityMethod: 100 ÷ (1 + e^(-(team projected total − opponent projected total) ÷ 12))

awards.note: Manual award. No pre-MNF projection was captured live for Week 1. A retrospective rebuild from ESPN data (points scored before MNF plus ESPN stored projections for starters still to play) ranks Nyle as the losing team with the highest win probability (66.6%), ahead of Gilguy (63.5%); see data/dick-brick-review-week1.json.
